title: elaphoglossum nigrescens
intro: Elaphoglossum nigrescens, commonly known as Black Elaphoglossum, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. The health benefits of Elaphoglossum nigrescens include its potential to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, as well as its ability to act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds.
